shape.situation_pattern: Shareable data exists but could include inner weather / sorting sludge that corrupts the physics.
shape.decision: Share the farm's physics, leave out the sludge; T0/T1 (keys, inner weather, decode maps) never board the public path.
shape.reasoning_physics: The share path is clean precisely because the important never leaves. Sharing everything isn't transparency—it drowns the transferable truth in what doesn't transfer.
